3223.title: Desktop startup failure view has no retry action
3223.rootCauseOneLine: The remote loader falls through to a static error model that has no retry state or action bridge back to the existing server-target application path.
3223.proposedFix: Mark recoverable startup failures explicitly, render a retry control only for those views, and route it over a fixed payload-free desktop IPC channel to the existing applyServerTarget path.
3223.caveats: The client-side dead end is reproduced directly; the reporter's private network and tunnel-health claims were not tested.
